t.E160e.agn: In 2014 EFSA raised the ADI from 0.05 to 0.3 mg/kg body weight and saw no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E160e.body: Normally only a small part of orally taken beta-apo-8'-carotenal is absorbed; at high doses almost all of it is excreted in faeces. The absorbed part is found in the liver together with vitamin A and beta-apo-8'-carotenoic acid; some of it is converted to vitamin A.
t.E160e.prod: A carotenoid produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E160e.regx.0: ADI raised to 0.3 mg/kg; no safety concern.
t.E160e.summary: An orange-red pigment from the carotenoid group. It also occurs in nature but is usually synthesised; used in sauces and confectionery.
